coastal.title: B.C. cat found on dock after Bradley Creek wildfire, burned and alone
coastal.description: The Bradley Creek wildfire had ripped through the area, and Erickson had been helping his neighbours survey the damage from a boat when he saw her.

coastal.title: Work begins to rebuild Port Coquitlam school destroyed by suspicious fire
coastal.description: Nearly three years after Port Coquitlam's Hazel Trembath Elementary School was destroyed in a suspicious fire, work is beginning on its replacement.

kamloops.title: After devastating Summerland fire, B.C. faces call to 'cut red tape' for prescribed burns
kamloops.description: As British Columbia grapples with wildfires of growing size and intensity, the province is facing calls to cut red tape to make conducting prescribed burns easier.

prince-george.title: Support pours in for mother of 2 killed in Prince George plane crash
prince-george.description: Alex Garneau was in a vehicle that was hit by a twin-engine aircraft that was forced to make an emergency landing on Foothills Boulevard on Thursday.

prince-george.title: New hatcheries will see up to 1 million more salmon raised and released into Fraser and Skeena Rivers annually
prince-george.description: "Salmon are not simply a resource," Lheidli T'enneh Chief Dolleen Logan said at the announcement held in Prince George Tuesday. "Salmon are relatives. They are a part of our culture, our identity, our laws, our responsibilities."

prince-george.title: Rosalyn Bird is latest MLA to leave Kerry-Lynne Findlay's B.C. Conservatives
prince-george.description: Rosalyn Bird, the MLA for Prince George-Valemount, is the latest MLA to leave the B.C. Conservative caucus. It comes on the heels of the departures of Ian Paton and Peter Milobar, who say they plan to set up a new political party.

prince-george.title: Dolly Parton's 'Jolene' may be named after British Columbia nurse
prince-george.description: A Prince George woman believes she may be the inspiration for the name in Dolly Parton's song Jolene. Juline Whelan met the singer in 1972 and matches the description of the little girl Parton says inspired the name behind the famous tune.

all.title: Wildland firefighters warned not to take supplements for smoke or PFAS exposure
all.description: A drug marketed to wildland firefighters exposed to smoke or PFAS shows no evidence of being effective, leading the International Association of Firefighters and the Food and Drug Administration to warn against its use. The drug, called glutathione, is marketed to fire fighters to remove toxins, but the IAFF says there are no scientific studies […]

all.title: Studying combined fuel treatments gives us a better picture of effectiveness
all.description: While many studies have established that fuel treatments are an effective wildfire mitigation tool, the gap in our understanding has been how a range of different treatments work together over many years across large areas to produce a desired outcome. Research led by Boise State University PhD student Kendra Fallon, now a National Fire Ecologist […]

all.title: Global wildland fire conference announced for Melbourne 2028
all.description: The largest international wildland fire conference is heading back to Australia in 2028. The 9th International Wildland Fire Conference will be held in Melbourne, Australia, from 4-7 April 2028 under the theme of “Fire Knowledge, shared across the world”. The once in every four years event was announced this week at the opening of the […]

all.title: Roadless Rule ‘entirely’ removed under new USDA proposal
all.description: The United States Department of Agriculture on Tuesday formally began the process of rescinding the Roadless Area Conservation Rule, opening the nation’s protected forests to new development, road construction, and intensive logging.
